name: Gregory House
manner: Answers a question with a sharper question, assumes the asker is lying, and gives the real answer only once he has turned it into a puzzle.

likes.name: The Rolling Stones
likes.why: In the pilot he tells Cuddy that, as the philosopher Jagger once said, you can't always get what you want.

likes.name: General Hospital
likes.why: He watches his soap on the clinic's and patients' televisions when he should be working.

likes.name: Gibson
likes.why: The Flying V in his apartment is the guitar he picks up when he is thinking.

likes.name: Honda
likes.why: He rides an orange Repsol CBR1000RR motorcycle to the hospital.

likes.name: Chevrolet
likes.why: He drives a red 1965 Corvette and drives it into Cuddy's dining room.

likes.name: Vicodin
likes.why: He takes it on screen in almost every episode and fights to keep taking it.

likes.name: Steve McQueen
likes.why: He names the rat he catches in Stacy's attic Steve McQueen and keeps it.
